description: This file contains test cases for the 'sandbox-tool-policy' module, verifying the behavior of the policy functions and configuration resolution within the 'openclaw' project.

methods.name: pickSandboxToolPolicy
methods.description: Determines the sandbox tool policy based on provided configuration, merging allow and alsoAllow lists appropriately, and passing through deny as-is.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the effective tool policy considering global and profile-specific configurations.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolFsRootExpansionAllowed
methods.description: Decides if filesystem root expansion is allowed based on configuration.

ctags.name: resolved
ctags.pattern: /^    const resolved = resolveEffectiveToolPolicy({ config: cfg, agentId: "main" });$/
